params.linkText: 2029 World Cruise: Iconic Islands & Remote Horizons

children: , an extraordinary 138-day luxury voyage aboard Seabourn Quest that invites travelers to experience some of the world's most captivating destinations across five continents. Sailing from Miami to Lisbon from January 7 through May 26, 2029, the remarkable journey spans more than 32,000 nautical miles and visits 58 destinations in 31 countries and territories and more than 25 UNESCO World Heritage Sites, combining iconic landmarks, remote islands and immersive cultural experiences accessible through thoughtfully curated travel.

Designed for travelers seeking meaningful exploration and unforgettable moments, the voyage will take guests through the Americas, South Pacific, New Zealand, Australia, Southeast Asia, the Indian Ocean, Africa and Europe. Along the way, guests will enjoy Seabourn's signature blend of personalized service, spacious oceanfront suites, world-class dining and exclusive experiences created specifically for World Cruise travelers.

"Our 2029 World Cruise exemplifies the type of extraordinary travel experiences that define Seabourn," said Mark Tamis, President of Seabourn. "This voyage combines globally celebrated destinations with some of the world's most remote and fascinating places, creating opportunities for deeper discovery and meaningful cultural connection. From exclusive shoreside events and immersive experiences to the personalized service and intimacy that set Seabourn apart, every element of this journey has been thoughtfully designed to inspire and enrich our guests."
A Voyage Connecting the World's Most Extraordinary Places

The 2029 World Cruise has been thoughtfully designed to balance world-renowned destinations with hidden gems rarely included in traditional itineraries. From the dramatic landscapes of Easter Island and the turquoise lagoons of Bora Bora to the vibrant cultures of Zanzibar and Cape Town, the journey offers guests opportunities to experience both celebrated landmarks and lesser-explored corners of the globe. Guests will also discover remote destinations such as Nuku Hiva in the Marquesas Islands, Praslin in the Seychelles, Antsiranana in Madagascar, Akaroa in New Zealand and Burnie in Tasmania.
Throughout the voyage, Seabourn Quest's intimate size allows access to ports and destinations often beyond the reach of larger vessels, creating a more immersive and authentic travel experience.

Along the way, guests will have opportunities to visit more than 25 UNESCO World Heritage sites, including Easter Island, Fiordland National Park, Stone Town of Zanzibar, and the Sacred City of Kandy (Colombo).
More Time in Remarkable Destinations
Designed to encourage deeper exploration, the itinerary includes 20 extended stays, including eight overnight calls.
Overnight calls include:
Lima, Peru
Easter Island, Chile
Bora Bora, French Polynesia
Bali, Indonesia
Singapore
Sydney, Australia
Zanzibar, Tanzania
Cape Town, South Africa
Additional extended stays include Cartagena, Auckland, Napier, Melbourne, Portland, Adelaide, Busselton, Fremantle, Colombo, Victoria, Walvis Bay and Las Palmas.

With extended stays and more time in port throughout the journey, guests can explore some of the world's most remarkable destinations at a more relaxed pace. Optional Seabourn Journeys programs provide opportunities to extend the adventure with immersive land experiences, including visits to the Galápagos Islands, Machu Picchu, Uluru, the Taj Mahal, African safari destinations and Easter Island.
Exclusive Experiences Created for World Cruise Guests

Specially designed for full World Cruise guests, Seabourn's signature shoreside events and immersive land experiences will provide unique opportunities to connect with the cultures, traditions and communities visited throughout the voyage.

Among the voyage's most anticipated experiences is an included two-day, one-night Seabourn Journey in Bali, where guests will enjoy private cultural encounters, authentic culinary experiences, village explorations and exclusive access to local traditions that reveal the island's rich heritage and artistic legacy.

In Cape Town, guests will be invited to an exclusive evening at the acclaimed Zeitz Museum of Contemporary Art Africa (MOCAA). Featuring private after-hours access, regional cuisine, live entertainment and sweeping views of Table Mountain, the bespoke event promises an unforgettable celebration of African culture, art and hospitality available exclusively to World Cruise guests.
Curated Experiences at Sea

The journey extends well beyond the destinations through experiences created exclusively for World Cruise guests. Throughout the voyage, Seabourn Quest will host destination-focused enrichment programs, expert speakers as part of the line's popular Seabourn Conversations program, culinary events and cultural performances and specially curated entertainment inspired by the regions visited. Guests will also enjoy the ships recently completed dry dock, featuring one of the most comprehensive interior updates in Seabourn's history, with refreshed suites, enhanced public spaces, updated dining venues and spa improvements designed to elevate comfort and luxury throughout the journey.

Days at sea offer opportunities for deeper engagement, learning and relaxation, allowing guests to connect with fellow travelers while enjoying the intuitive service, welcoming atmosphere and yacht-like environment that have become hallmarks of the Seabourn experience.
Exclusive Amenities for Full World Cruise Guests
Guests sailing the complete 138-day World Cruise will enjoy a suite of premium inclusions designed to provide exceptional value and a seamless travel experience:
Up to $4,000 USD shipboard credit per Veranda Suite
Up to $8,000 USD shipboard credit per Penthouse Suite and above
Round-trip Business Class air
One-night pre-cruise hotel stay in Miami
Included two-day, one-night Bali Seabourn Journey
Upgraded Stream Wi-Fi package powered by Starlink for two devices
Unlimited laundry, wet cleaning and pressing
Reduced 50% deposit at booking
Exclusive commemorative gifts
Flexible Voyage Options

For guests seeking a shorter World Cruise experience, Seabourn will also offer a selection of extended voyage segments. These options provide the opportunity to explore some of the world's most captivating destinations across multiple regions, while enjoying the same exceptional experiences, enrichment and service featured on the full World Cruise. Additional details on segment itineraries and availability will be announced closer to launch.

Exclusive World Cruise amenities are reserved for guests sailing the complete 138-day voyage. Guests who reserve the full World Cruise or eligible voyage segments by September 17, 2026, will receive a 10% early booking savings.

About Seabourn:

Seabourn represents the pinnacle of luxury ocean and expedition travel and operates a suite of five modern ships. The all-inclusive, boutique ships offer all-suite accommodations with ocean-front views; award-winning dining; complimentary premium spirits and fine wines available at all times; renowned service provided by an industry-leading crew; a relaxed, sociable atmosphere that makes guests feel at home; a pedigree in expedition travel through the Ventures by Seabourn® program and two luxury purpose-built expedition ships, including Seabourn Venture that launched in 2022 and Seabourn Pursuit in 2023. Seabourn takes travelers to every continent on the globe, visiting more than 400 ports including marquee cities and lesser-known ports and hideaways. Guests of Seabourn experience extraordinary offerings and programs, including partnerships with leading entertainers, dining, personal health and wellbeing, and engaging speakers.
